audienceSections.normal: Use [[grammar:verb stem + (으)러 + motion verb]] to state the purpose of going or coming somewhere.
audienceSections.expert: Purposive [[grammar:-(으)러]] is selected by stem-final phonology and requires a following directed-motion predicate.

audienceSections.normal:
Attach [[grammar:-러]] or [[grammar:-으러]] to the purpose action, then use a motion verb such as [[grammar:가다]], [[grammar:오다]], or [[grammar:들어가다]]: [[grammar:사진을 찍으러 공원에 가요]].

Example: [[grammar:이준호는 사진을 찍으러 공원에 가요.]]
audienceSections.expert:
[[grammar:-(으)러]] is a purposive connective selected by stem-final phonology and restricted to a following directed-motion predicate. The purpose clause and motion clause share an understood subject in these examples.

Example: [[grammar:이준호는 사진을 찍으러 공원에 가요.]]

audienceSections.normal: Korean places the purpose before the destination and motion verb. Full names reappear when the narrative shifts the acting participant; shared and recoverable subjects are omitted in the remaining clauses.
audienceSections.expert: Korean places the purpose before the destination and motion verb. Full names reappear when the narrative shifts the acting participant; shared and recoverable subjects are omitted in the remaining clauses.

audienceSections.normal: Junho and Sujin visit the museum district for maps, photographs, lunch, and small program materials.
audienceSections.expert: Purpose clauses with `-(으)러` precede directed-motion predicates, while explicit participant restatement prevents ambiguous subject shifts.

breakdown.normal:
- 토요일에 이준호는 박물관에 가요. — On Saturday, Lee Junho goes to the museum.
- 이준호는 지도를 보러 안내소에 가요. — Junho goes to the information desk to look at a map.
- 박물관에는 사진을 보러 들어가요. — He enters the museum to look at photographs.
- 두 사람은 점심을 먹으러 카페에 가요. — The two people go to a café to eat lunch.
- 오후에는 정수진이 선물을 사러 시장에 가요. — In the afternoon, Jeong Sujin goes to the market to buy a gift.
- 이준호는 사진을 찍으러 공원에 가요. — Lee Junho goes to the park to take photographs.
- 정수진은 엽서를 사러 가게에 가요. — Sujin goes to a shop to buy a postcard.
- 저녁에는 두 사람이 집에 돌아와요. — In the evening, the two people return home.
